# FG-GIT-0025

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | [`push-checks`](../../ops/runbooks/push-checks.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `allow_import_refuses_a_repository_with_refs` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 履歴の取り込みを許可できませんでした。リポジトリが空であることを確認してください。
- en: The history import could not be allowed. Make sure the repository is empty.
- id: Impor riwayat tidak dapat diizinkan. Pastikan repositori masih kosong.

## 原因 (cause)

`forge admin repo allow-import <repo_id> [--ttl-hours N]` (2026-11-12, ADR-0008 amendment "history import") refused to allow the one-time history import: `reason=repository_not_empty` (the repository already has refs: the allowance is only for the first push into an empty repository), `repository_not_ready` (the repository is still `provisioning` or is being purged), `ttl_out_of_range` (the TTL is outside 1 to 168 hours). Nothing was written.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The CLI prints the code and fails; its log line carries `reason`, `repo_id` and, for `repository_not_empty`, `refs` (the refs read). Check read-only: `git --git-dir=$(forge admin repo-path <repo_id>) for-each-ref | head` and `forge doctor` (repositories).

## 対処 (fix)

Use the allowance only on a new, empty repository (create a new project for the import, or delete its refs first with an approved step). Pick a TTL between 1 and 168 hours. Runbook push-checks, "history import".
